summary: p02 ch01 k4 (130-169): 16 errors, 39 minor. Main errors: 162 wrong sandhi split (yasmāt for asmāt) feeding both translations; four false typo flags on regular sandhi (138, 140 x2, 143, 144 suggest) and a wrong flag src in 155; 136 Hindi/English add 'plants' and 'if'; 151 Hindi adds 'पुरुष के'; 140 Hindi adds 'फल'; 158 Hindi adds 'स्वभाव'; 161 and 136 gram genders; 165 supplied noun 'woman'. Identifications (vaṭaśuṅga, udumbara, apāmārga standard; sahadevā, sahacara, agnijihvā, utpala, kumuda probable; lakṣmaṇā, śveta-bṛhatī, śaṅkhapuṣpī, jīvaka, ṛṣabhaka disputed; viśvedevā unidentified) are correctly tagged. Damaged units 136, 141, 152, 157, 160 handled per glossary. Human decisions: 136 viśvedevā vs viśvadevā, 142 sthitāṃ vs sthitā, 156 '(verses)', 168 tu, 138 root label nāvayet. No regrouping beyond the draft's 147-148, 157-158, 161-162 notes.
glossary_suggestions: Sandhi: final -āḥ / -āyāḥ before a voiced consonant loses the visarga (brāhmaṇā vṛddha-, puṣyoddhṛtāyā lakṣmaṇāyā mūla-); do not flag such forms as typos (4 false flags in p02 ch01 k4).
Verse-closing 'iti' joined to the previous word: vidhibhir iti (r), not vidhibhiḥ iti.
puṃsavana = rite to obtain a male child (standard); nāvayet = should instil into the nose (nasya); when the agent is not stated (138, 139, 142) use 'one', not 'she'.
jīvanīya and prajāsthāpana are named drug groups (Caraka Sūtra 4); jīvaka and ṛṣabhaka (aṣṭavarga) = Malaxis acuminata and M. muscifera, disputed.
śukra said of both sexes (151, 167): 'reproductive fluid' in Hindi प्रजनन द्रव and English; never add 'पुरुष के'.
Adjective alone as subject (daivatācāra...ratā): 'She who is devoted ...' / 'जो ... रत है, वह', not 'A woman ...'.
